definition.name: ResolveFlow Supervisor R2
definition.description: Picks the most urgent unresolved ticket, opens it as a case in the Command Center, and hands it to RF-03 - which asks the policy gate before it acts. Reports the outcome by reading it back from the Command Center rather than asserting it.

envs.name: SUPABASE_TOKEN
envs.description: Supabase service_role JWT, or a personal access token.

inputs.name: command_center_url
inputs.description: Public URL of the Command Center.
inputs.label: Command Center URL

steps.name: RF-01 Rank the Backlog
steps.description: Rank every unresolved ticket by SLA urgency.

subworkflow_call.input_mapping_code_cell:
import sys from IPython.display import HTML, display _subworkflow_inputs_rank_backlog = { "output_filename": user_inputs.get("output_filename") or "ranked_tickets.csv", "supabase_url": user_inputs.get("supabase_url"), } print("Handing off to RF-01:", _subworkflow_inputs_rank_backlog) display(HTML("""

Step 1 - rank the backlog

RF-01 reads every unresolved ticket and ranks it by SLA state, priority, VIP reporter and age. The Supervisor does not decide what is urgent; the Operator that owns that job does.

"""))

steps.name: Open the Most Urgent Case
steps.description: Take the top-ranked ticket and open a run in the Command Center.
steps.code_cell:
import os, sys, json, httpx from IPython.display import HTML, display async def _key(url, token): if token and token.startswith("eyJ"): return token ref = url.split("//")[1].split(".")[0] async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20.0) as c: r = await c.get(f"https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/{ref}/api-keys", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}) r.raise_for_status() for k in r.json(): if k.get("name") == "service_role": return k.get("api_key") raise Exception("Could not resolve a Supabase service_role key.") def _get(row, *names): for n in names: for c in (n, n.lower(), n.replace(" ", "_").lower()): if c in row and row[c] not in (None, ""): return row[c] return None def _age_days(value): from datetime import datetime text = str(value or "").strip() for fmt in ("%b %d %Y", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%d", "%d/%m/%Y"): try: return (datetime(2030, 1, 1) - datetime.strptime(text, fmt)).days except ValueError: continue return None async def step_open_case_run(): supabase_url = (user_inputs.get("supabase_url") or "").rstrip("/") base = (user_inputs.get("command_center_url") or "").rstrip("/") token = os.environ.get("SUPABASE_TOKEN") key = await _key(supabase_url, token) headers = {"apikey": key, "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"} # Prefer whatever RF-01 left behind. If the platform surfaces a # subworkflow's result under a different name than expected, fall back to # applying the same ranking rule here rather than failing the chain - but # say which path was taken, so nobody has to guess afterwards. state = globals().setdefault("workflow_step_state", {}) ranked = state.get("rank_backlog") or globals().get("step_rank_backlog_output") source = "RF-01 output" top = None if isinstance(ranked, list) and ranked: top = ranked[0].get("ticket_id") if isinstance(ranked[0], dict) else None if not top: source = "recomputed by the Supervisor (RF-01 output not readable here)" out, step, off = [], 1000, 0 async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60.0) as c: while True: r = await c.get(f"{supabase_url}/rest/v1/issues", params={"select": "*", "limit": str(step), "offset": str(off)}, headers=headers) if r.status_code not in (200, 206): raise Exception(f"issues: HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text[:200]}") page = r.json() out += page if len(page) < step: break off += step openish = [x for x in out if str(_get(x, "status") or "").strip().lower() not in ("resolved", "closed", "done")] def score(x): sla = str(_get(x, "customfield_10030_time_to_resolution") or "").lower() s = 3000 if "breach" in sla else 2000 if "risk" in sla else 1000 if "within" in sla else 0 s += {"Highest": 400, "High": 300, "Medium": 200, "Low": 100}.get(str(_get(x, "priority") or ""), 0) age = _age_days(_get(x, "created")) return s + (min(age / 100.0, 50.0) if age is not None else 0) openish.sort(key=score, reverse=True) top = _get(openish[0], "issue_key") if openish else None if not top: raise ValueError("No unresolved ticket to work.") # Open the case in the Command Center so this work is on the record before # anything touches a live system. A run id is what makes the Passport, the # policy evaluation and the outcome ledger all refer to the same case. async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30.0) as c: r = await c.post(f"{base}/api/agent/runs", json={"issue_key": top, "trigger_source": "supervisor"}, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "ngrok-skip-browser-warning": "1"}) run = r.json() run_id = run.get("id") if not run_id: raise Exception(f"Command Center did not return a run id: {str(run)[:200]}") # Auto puts this run's own identity in the cell globals. Report it so the # Command Center can point at the Auto execution behind this case - the # execute endpoint has never let us record one from the outside. auto_run_id = globals().get("workflow_run_id") if auto_run_id: try: async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20.0) as c: await c.post( f"{base}/api/agent/runs/{run_id}/events", json={"operator_name": "ORCHESTRATOR", "event_type": "AUTO_RUN_LINKED", "event_status": "ok", "payload": {"auto_run_id": auto_run_id, "workflow_id": globals().get("workflow_id"), "detail": "Reported by the Supervisor from " "inside its own Auto execution."}}, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "ngrok-skip-browser-warning": "1"}) except Exception as exc: print(f"Could not link the Auto run id: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}") state["case"] = {"issue_key": top, "run_id": run_id, "source": source, "auto_run_id": auto_run_id} globals()["supervisor_case"] = state["case"] print(json.dumps(state["case"], indent=2)) display(HTML("""

Step 2 - open the most urgent case

Ticket""" + str(top) + """
Run id""" + str(run_id) + """
Chosen from""" + source + """
Auto run id""" + str(auto_run_id or "not exposed") + """

The case exists in the Command Center before any action is proposed. Nothing has been decided yet.

""")) await step_open_case_run()

steps.name: RF-03 Work the Case Through the Gate
steps.description: Match, score, ask the policy gate, then act or escalate.

subworkflow_call.input_mapping_code_cell:
import sys from IPython.display import HTML, display case = (globals().get("workflow_step_state", {}) or {}).get("case") \ or globals().get("supervisor_case") if not case: raise ValueError("No case in state. Did open_case run?") _subworkflow_inputs_work_the_case = { "issue_key": case["issue_key"], "run_id": case["run_id"], "supabase_url": user_inputs.get("supabase_url"), "command_center_url": user_inputs.get("command_center_url"), "test_recipient_email": user_inputs.get("test_recipient_email"), } print("Handing off to RF-03:", json.dumps(_subworkflow_inputs_work_the_case, indent=2) if "json" in dir() else _subworkflow_inputs_work_the_case) display(HTML("""

Step 3 - hand the case to RF-03

RF-03 matches the ticket to a cleared knowledge base article, scores the fix, and asks the policy gate for permission. The Supervisor cannot skip that gate; it does not have a route around it.

steps.name: Report What Happened
steps.description: Read the outcome back from the Command Center.
steps.code_cell:
import os, sys, json, httpx from IPython.display import HTML, display async def _key(url, token): if token and token.startswith("eyJ"): return token ref = url.split("//")[1].split(".")[0] async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20.0) as c: r = await c.get(f"https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/{ref}/api-keys", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}) r.raise_for_status() for k in r.json(): if k.get("name") == "service_role": return k.get("api_key") raise Exception("Could not resolve a Supabase service_role key.") def _get(row, *names): for n in names: for c in (n, n.lower(), n.replace(" ", "_").lower()): if c in row and row[c] not in (None, ""): return row[c] return None async def step_report_run(): base = (user_inputs.get("command_center_url") or "").rstrip("/") case = (globals().get("workflow_step_state", {}) or {}).get("case") \ or globals().get("supervisor_case") if not case: raise ValueError("No case in state.") run_id = case["run_id"] h = {"ngrok-skip-browser-warning": "1"} async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30.0) as c: run = (await c.get(f"{base}/api/agent/runs/{run_id}", headers=h)).json() events = (await c.get(f"{base}/api/agent/runs/{run_id}/events", headers=h)).json() summary = (await c.get(f"{base}/api/agent/summary", headers=h)).json() # Report what the Command Center recorded, not what this chain intended. # The Round 1 summary counted columns that no longer exist and printed # zeroes with total confidence; asking the system of record instead means # this panel cannot claim an outcome that did not happen. verdicts = [e for e in events if e.get("event_type") == "POLICY_EVALUATED"] status = run.get("status") rows = "" for e in events: rows += ("" + str(e.get("event_type")) + "" + str(e.get("operator_name")) + "" + str(e.get("event_status") or "") + "") print(json.dumps({"issue_key": case["issue_key"], "run_id": run_id, "status": status, "events": len(events), "policy_evaluations": len(verdicts), "verified_resolved_total": summary.get("verified_resolved"), "auto_resolution_rate": summary.get("auto_resolution_rate")}, indent=2, default=str)) display(HTML("""

Step 4 - what actually happened

Ticket""" + str(case["issue_key"]) + """
Outcome""" + str(status) + """
Policy evaluations""" + str(len(verdicts)) + """
Verified resolutions on the ledger""" + str(summary.get("verified_resolved")) + """
Unattended share""" + str(summary.get("auto_resolution_rate")) + """%

Event trail

""" + rows + """
EventReported by Status

Every line above was read back from the Command Center. A refusal or an escalation is a result, not a failure - if this case was denied, the Passport names the condition that was not met.

Full trace: """ + base + """/runs/""" + str(run_id) + """

""")) await step_report_run()

definition.name: RF-01 SLA Rescue Coordinator
definition.description: Ranks every unresolved ticket by SLA state, priority, VIP reporter and age, and writes a prioritised CSV. Rebuilt for the Round 2 schema: lowercase column names, no configuration table, and the service_role JWT used directly instead of a Supabase Management API round trip.

envs.name: SUPABASE_URL
envs.description: Supabase project URL (optional; the supabase_url input wins).

envs.name: SUPABASE_TOKEN
envs.description: Supabase service_role JWT, or a personal access token.

steps.name: Fetch Issues
steps.description: Fetch every ticket from Supabase and keep the ones that are not resolved or closed.
steps.code_cell:
import os, sys, json, httpx from IPython.display import HTML, display async def _resolve_service_key(supabase_url, token): """SUPABASE_TOKEN may be a service_role JWT or a personal access token.""" if token and token.startswith("eyJ"): return token project_ref = supabase_url.split("//")[1].split(".")[0] async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20.0) as client: resp = await client.get( f"https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/{project_ref}/api-keys", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, ) resp.raise_for_status() for k in resp.json(): if k.get("name") == "service_role": return k.get("api_key") raise Exception("Could not resolve a Supabase service_role key.") def _sb_context(): url = (user_inputs.get("supabase_url") or os.environ.get("SUPABASE_URL") or "").rstrip("/") token = os.environ.get("SUPABASE_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") if not url: raise ValueError("No Supabase URL: set the supabase_url input or SUPABASE_URL.") if not token: raise ValueError("Environment variable SUPABASE_TOKEN is missing.") return url, token async def _page_all(client, url, headers, table, select="*", extra=""): """PostgREST caps a page; fetch until short. 460 rows fit in one page, but paging costs nothing and survives the table growing.""" out, step, off = [], 1000, 0 while True: r = await client.get( f"{url}/rest/v1/{table}", params={"select": select, "limit": str(step), "offset": str(off)}, headers=headers, ) if r.status_code not in (200, 206): raise Exception(f"{table}: HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text[:200]}") page = r.json() out += page if len(page) < step: return out off += step def _get(row, *names): """Round 2 column names are lowercase snake_case. Round 1 used title case. Accept either so this Operator is not brittle about which load it meets.""" for n in names: for c in (n, n.lower(), n.replace(" ", "_").lower()): if c in row and row[c] not in (None, ""): return row[c] return None async def step_fetch_issues_run(): url, token = _sb_context() key = await _resolve_service_key(url, token) headers = {"apikey": key, "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Accept": "application/json"} # The Round 2 column is lowercase "status". The Round 1 build asked for # "Status" and PostgREST is case sensitive, which is why every fetch died. async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60.0) as client: rows = await _page_all(client, url, headers, "issues") issues = [r for r in rows if str(_get(r, "status") or "").strip().lower() not in ("resolved", "closed", "done")] state = globals().setdefault("workflow_step_state", {}) state["fetch_issues"] = issues print(json.dumps({"fetched": len(rows), "unresolved": len(issues)}, indent=2)) counts = {} for i in issues: p = str(_get(i, "priority") or "Unknown") counts[p] = counts.get(p, 0) + 1 badges = "" for p, n in sorted(counts.items()): badges += f'{p}: {n}' display(HTML(f"""

Unresolved tickets loaded

Read {len(rows)} tickets from the system of record; {len(issues)} are still open and eligible for SLA ranking.

By priority
{badges}
""")) await step_fetch_issues_run()

steps.name: Fetch Configuration
steps.description: States the ranking weights in use. Round 2 has no configuration table, so built-in defaults are shown.
steps.code_cell:
import os, sys, json, httpx from IPython.display import HTML, display async def _resolve_service_key(supabase_url, token): """SUPABASE_TOKEN may be a service_role JWT or a personal access token.""" if token and token.startswith("eyJ"): return token project_ref = supabase_url.split("//")[1].split(".")[0] async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20.0) as client: resp = await client.get( f"https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/{project_ref}/api-keys", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, ) resp.raise_for_status() for k in resp.json(): if k.get("name") == "service_role": return k.get("api_key") raise Exception("Could not resolve a Supabase service_role key.") def _sb_context(): url = (user_inputs.get("supabase_url") or os.environ.get("SUPABASE_URL") or "").rstrip("/") token = os.environ.get("SUPABASE_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") if not url: raise ValueError("No Supabase URL: set the supabase_url input or SUPABASE_URL.") if not token: raise ValueError("Environment variable SUPABASE_TOKEN is missing.") return url, token async def _page_all(client, url, headers, table, select="*", extra=""): """PostgREST caps a page; fetch until short. 460 rows fit in one page, but paging costs nothing and survives the table growing.""" out, step, off = [], 1000, 0 while True: r = await client.get( f"{url}/rest/v1/{table}", params={"select": select, "limit": str(step), "offset": str(off)}, headers=headers, ) if r.status_code not in (200, 206): raise Exception(f"{table}: HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text[:200]}") page = r.json() out += page if len(page) < step: return out off += step def _get(row, *names): """Round 2 column names are lowercase snake_case. Round 1 used title case. Accept either so this Operator is not brittle about which load it meets.""" for n in names: for c in (n, n.lower(), n.replace(" ", "_").lower()): if c in row and row[c] not in (None, ""): return row[c] return None async def step_fetch_config_run(): """ Round 2 has no config table. Round 1 did, and the old build halted the whole ranking when it could not find one. Stating the defaults out loud is more honest than pretending a table was read, and it keeps the step in the graph so the shape of the Operator is unchanged. """ defaults = {"vip_boost": 250.0, "sla_breach_weight": 3000.0, "sla_at_risk_weight": 2000.0, "sla_within_weight": 1000.0} state = globals().setdefault("workflow_step_state", {}) state["fetch_config"] = {"items": [], "lookup": defaults, "source": "built-in defaults"} print(json.dumps(state["fetch_config"], indent=2)) rows = "" for k, v in sorted(defaults.items()): rows += f'{k}{v}' display(HTML(f"""

Ranking weights

The Round 2 dataset carries no configuration table, so these built-in weights are used. They are shown here rather than hidden in code, because a weight nobody can see is a weight nobody can check.

{rows}
SettingValue
""")) await step_fetch_config_run()

steps.name: Fetch Users
steps.description: Fetch user details from the Supabase users_directory table to identify VIPs.
steps.code_cell:
import os, sys, json, httpx from IPython.display import HTML, display async def _resolve_service_key(supabase_url, token): """SUPABASE_TOKEN may be a service_role JWT or a personal access token.""" if token and token.startswith("eyJ"): return token project_ref = supabase_url.split("//")[1].split(".")[0] async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20.0) as client: resp = await client.get( f"https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/{project_ref}/api-keys", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, ) resp.raise_for_status() for k in resp.json(): if k.get("name") == "service_role": return k.get("api_key") raise Exception("Could not resolve a Supabase service_role key.") def _sb_context(): url = (user_inputs.get("supabase_url") or os.environ.get("SUPABASE_URL") or "").rstrip("/") token = os.environ.get("SUPABASE_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") if not url: raise ValueError("No Supabase URL: set the supabase_url input or SUPABASE_URL.") if not token: raise ValueError("Environment variable SUPABASE_TOKEN is missing.") return url, token async def _page_all(client, url, headers, table, select="*", extra=""): """PostgREST caps a page; fetch until short. 460 rows fit in one page, but paging costs nothing and survives the table growing.""" out, step, off = [], 1000, 0 while True: r = await client.get( f"{url}/rest/v1/{table}", params={"select": select, "limit": str(step), "offset": str(off)}, headers=headers, ) if r.status_code not in (200, 206): raise Exception(f"{table}: HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text[:200]}") page = r.json() out += page if len(page) < step: return out off += step def _get(row, *names): """Round 2 column names are lowercase snake_case. Round 1 used title case. Accept either so this Operator is not brittle about which load it meets.""" for n in names: for c in (n, n.lower(), n.replace(" ", "_").lower()): if c in row and row[c] not in (None, ""): return row[c] return None async def step_fetch_users_run(): url, token = _sb_context() key = await _resolve_service_key(url, token) headers = {"apikey": key, "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Accept": "application/json"} async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60.0) as client: users = await _page_all(client, url, headers, "users_directory") state = globals().setdefault("workflow_step_state", {}) state["fetch_users"] = users vips = sum(1 for u in users if str(_get(u, "x_vip") or "").strip().lower() in ("true", "1", "t", "yes")) print(json.dumps({"users": len(users), "vip": vips}, indent=2)) display(HTML(f"""

User directory loaded

Users
{len(users)}

steps.name: Rank Tickets
steps.description: Process the tickets, apply ranking logic based on SLA, Priority, VIP status, and Age, and generate a sorted list. Save the list to a CSV file.
steps.code_cell:
import json, sys import pandas as pd from datetime import datetime from IPython.display import HTML, display def _get(row, *names): for n in names: for c in (n, n.lower(), n.replace(" ", "_").lower()): if c in row and row[c] not in (None, ""): return row[c] return None def _age_days(value): """ Two date shapes live in this export: "Jul 14 2026" and "2026-07-07 00:00:00". Only 16% of rows record a real time of day, so age is measured in whole days and no detection window is inferred from a midnight that was never observed. """ text = str(value or "").strip() for fmt in ("%b %d %Y", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%d", "%d/%m/%Y"): try: return (datetime(2030, 1, 1) - datetime.strptime(text, fmt)).days except ValueError: continue return None async def step_rank_tickets_run(): state = globals().setdefault("workflow_step_state", {}) issues = state.get("fetch_issues", []) users = state.get("fetch_users", []) cfg = (state.get("fetch_config") or {}).get("lookup", {}) output_filename = user_inputs.get("output_filename", "ranked_tickets.csv") if not issues: raise ValueError("No unresolved tickets in state. Did fetch_issues run?") vip = {str(_get(u, "display_name") or "").strip().lower(): str(_get(u, "x_vip") or "").strip().lower() in ("true", "1", "t", "yes") for u in users} w_breach = float(cfg.get("sla_breach_weight", 3000)) w_risk = float(cfg.get("sla_at_risk_weight", 2000)) w_within = float(cfg.get("sla_within_weight", 1000)) w_vip = float(cfg.get("vip_boost", 250)) ranked, incomplete = [], 0 for i in issues: key = _get(i, "issue_key", "Issue key") or _get(i, "issue_id") or "UNKNOWN" sla = str(_get(i, "customfield_10030_time_to_resolution", "customfield_10030 (Time to resolution)") or "").strip() priority = str(_get(i, "priority") or "").strip() created = _get(i, "created") reporter = str(_get(i, "reporter") or "").strip().lower() # A missing field is reported, never guessed. An invented urgency is # worse than an admitted gap. missing = [n for n, v in (("time to resolution", sla), ("priority", priority), ("created", created)) if not v] if missing: incomplete += 1 ranked.append({"ticket_id": key, "rescue_priority": "Needs review", "sla_status": sla or "not recorded", "reason": "missing: " + ", ".join(missing), "recommended_next_action": "Send to human review", "data_quality_issue": True, "_score": -1}) continue score = (w_breach if "breach" in sla.lower() else w_risk if "risk" in sla.lower() else w_within if "within" in sla.lower() else 0.0) score += {"Highest": 400, "High": 300, "Medium": 200, "Low": 100}.get(priority, 0) if vip.get(reporter): score += w_vip age = _age_days(created) if age is not None: score += min(age / 100.0, 50.0) band = ("Critical" if score >= w_breach else "High" if score >= w_risk else "Normal") ranked.append({"ticket_id": key, "rescue_priority": band, "sla_status": sla, "reason": f"SLA {sla} | priority {priority}" + (" | VIP reporter" if vip.get(reporter) else ""), "recommended_next_action": "Expedite" if band == "Critical" else "Monitor", "data_quality_issue": False, "_score": score}) ranked.sort(key=lambda r: r["_score"], reverse=True) for r in ranked: r.pop("_score", None) pd.DataFrame(ranked).to_csv(output_filename, index=False) state["rank_tickets"] = ranked bands = {} for r in ranked: bands[r["rescue_priority"]] = bands.get(r["rescue_priority"], 0) + 1 print(json.dumps({"ranked": len(ranked), "bands": bands, "incomplete": incomplete}, indent=2)) rows = "" for r in ranked[:8]: tid = r["ticket_id"]; band = r["rescue_priority"] sla_txt = r["sla_status"]; act = r["recommended_next_action"] rows += f"{tid}{band}{sla_txt}{act}" display(HTML(f"""

SLA rescue ranking complete

{len(ranked)} unresolved tickets ranked. {incomplete} could not be scored because a required field was not recorded; those are listed for human review rather than given an invented urgency.

{rows}
TicketBand SLAAction

Saved to {output_filename}

""")) await step_rank_tickets_run()

steps.name: Upload Results
steps.description: Upload the generated ranked tickets CSV file for download.
steps.agent_prompt: Use the 'upload_output_file' predefined function to upload the CSV file generated in the previous step (filename is in user_inputs['output_filename']). Output the URL of the uploaded file so it can be downloaded.
steps.code_cell:
import os import sys import json from IPython.display import HTML, display async def step_upload_results_execute(): """ Implements the 'upload_results' step. Uploads the CSV generated by the ranking step to storage and provides a download link. """ # 1. Configuration & Namespacing # Using specific namespaced variable names for safety and clarity step_id = "upload_results" workflow_step_state = globals().setdefault("workflow_step_state", {}) # Retrieve filename from user inputs (configured at start of workflow) # Defaulting to ranked_tickets.csv if somehow missing step_upload_results_filename = user_inputs.get('output_filename', 'ranked_tickets.csv') # 2. Artifact Verification # Ensure the file exists before calling the upload service if not os.path.exists(step_upload_results_filename): error_msg = f"Missing artifact: The file '{step_upload_results_filename}' was not found. Ensure preceding steps completed successfully." print(error_msg, file=sys.stderr) raise FileNotFoundError(error_msg) # 3. Action: Upload File to Storage # The platform's helper function 'upload_output_file' handles the cloud storage integration try: step_upload_results_url = await upload_output_file(step_upload_results_filename) except Exception as e: error_trace = f"Failed to upload {step_upload_results_filename}: {str(e)}" print(error_trace, file=sys.stderr) raise RuntimeError(error_trace) from e # 4. State Persistence # Store results in the workflow state and global namespace for potential later access step_output_payload = { "file_url": step_upload_results_url, "filename": step_upload_results_filename, "status": "success", "timestamp": str(os.path.getmtime(step_upload_results_filename)) } globals()[f"step_{step_id}_output"] = step_output_payload workflow_step_state[step_id] = step_output_payload # 5. Standard Output # Print the payload as valid JSON for logging and downstream processing print(json.dumps(step_output_payload, indent=2)) # 6. User Interface (Atmospheric Glass) # Render the download link and status badge to the UI display(HTML(f"""

definition.name: RF-03 Resolution Specialist
definition.description: Takes one ticket, matches it to a cleared knowledge base article, scores the proposed fix on confidence, reversibility, production impact and blast radius, then asks the Command Center policy gate for permission before acting. Branches three ways on the verdict: apply and verify, hold for a human, or refuse. Never invents a value for an absent field.

steps.name: Fetch Ticket and Detect Missing Evidence
steps.description: Read one ticket from the system of record and list any required field that is absent.
steps.agent_prompt: Fetch the single row from the Supabase 'issues' table whose key equals the 'issue_key' input. Try the column 'issue_key' then 'Issue key'. If no row is found, stop with an error naming the ticket. Then check whether Summary, Description, Priority and x_confidence (or confidence_score) are present. Store the ticket in rf03_ticket, the list of absent fields in rf03_missing_fields, and a boolean rf03_fields_complete. Never substitute a default for an absent field.

import os import httpx import json import sys from IPython.display import HTML, display async def _resolve_service_key(supabase_url, token): """ SUPABASE_TOKEN may be either a service_role JWT (starts with 'eyJ') or a Supabase personal access token. Accept both so this Operator runs in a clean workspace without a new secret being configured. """ if token and token.startswith("eyJ"): return token project_ref = supabase_url.split("//")[1].split(".")[0] async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20.0) as client: resp = await client.get( f"https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/{project_ref}/api-keys", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, ) resp.raise_for_status() for k in resp.json(): if k.get("name") == "service_role": return k.get("api_key") raise Exception("Could not resolve a Supabase service_role key from SUPABASE_TOKEN.") def _get(row, *names): """ Column tolerance. The Supabase 'issues' table currently carries the Round 1 enrichment spelling (confidence_score, auto_safe, ...) while the Round 2 export uses x_ prefixes. Accept either rather than guessing one. """ for n in names: for candidate in (n, n.lower(), n.replace(" ", "_"), n.replace("_", " ")): if candidate in row and row[candidate] not in (None, ""): return row[candidate] return None def _truthy(v): return str(v).strip().lower() in ("true", "1", "yes", "y", "t") async def step_fetch_ticket_run(): supabase_url = (user_inputs.get("supabase_url") or "").rstrip("/") issue_key = (user_inputs.get("issue_key") or "").strip() token = os.environ.get("SUPABASE_TOKEN") if not issue_key: raise ValueError("Input 'issue_key' is required. RF-03 acts on one ticket.") if not supabase_url: raise ValueError("Input 'supabase_url' is required.") if not token: raise ValueError("Environment variable 'SUPABASE_TOKEN' is missing.") key = await _resolve_service_key(supabase_url, token) headers = {"apikey": key, "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Accept": "application/json"} # The key column is 'issue_key' in the loaded table and 'Issue key' in the # raw export. Try both before concluding the ticket does not exist. ticket = None async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20.0) as client: for col in ("issue_key", "Issue key"): r = await client.get( f"{supabase_url}/rest/v1/issues", params={"select": "*", col: f"eq.{issue_key}"}, headers=headers, ) if r.status_code == 200 and r.json(): ticket = r.json()[0] break if ticket is None: raise Exception( f"Ticket {issue_key} does not exist in the system of record. " "RF-03 stops rather than proceeding on an empty record." ) # ---- missing required evidence --------------------------------------- # The dataset deliberately nulls x_confidence (143 rows), first_response_time # (192), x_escalation_risk (58) and Assignee (37). The brief is explicit: # pause and escalate, never invent a value. RF-03 only REPORTS what is # absent — the policy decides what that means. required = { "Summary": _get(ticket, "Summary", "summary"), "Description": _get(ticket, "Description", "description"), "Priority": _get(ticket, "Priority", "priority"), "x_confidence": _get(ticket, "x_confidence", "confidence_score"), } missing = sorted([name for name, value in required.items() if value in (None, "")]) globals()["rf03_ticket"] = ticket globals()["rf03_missing_fields"] = missing globals()["rf03_fields_complete"] = len(missing) == 0 status_badge = ("ag-badge-neutral" if not missing else "ag-badge-warn") rows = "".join( f"{k}{'ABSENT' if v in (None, '') else v}" for k, v in required.items() ) display(HTML(f"""

Ticket {issue_key}

{_get(ticket, 'Summary', 'summary') or '(no summary)'}

Required evidence: {'complete' if not missing else 'MISSING: ' + ', '.join(missing)}

{rows}
FieldValue

No value has been substituted for an absent field.

""")) await step_fetch_ticket_run()

RF-03 cannot " "propose a fix without a cleared article.") globals()["rf03_kb_articles"] = articles auto_safe_count = sum(1 for a in articles if _truthy(_get(a, "x_auto_safe", "auto_safe"))) display(HTML(f"""

steps.name: Match Knowledge Base Article
steps.description: Score every article against the ticket and pick the best defensible match, or none.
steps.agent_prompt: Score each article in rf03_kb_articles against the ticket text by vocabulary overlap, weighting coverage of the article's own terms. If the ticket names a kb_article_id, that article scores 0.95. If the best score is below 0.20, return no match rather than forcing one. Multiply the match score by the ticket's own x_confidence to produce rf03_confidence, so a low-confidence intake cannot become a high-confidence autonomous fix. Store rf03_kb_match and rf03_confidence.
steps.code_cell:
import json import re import sys from IPython.display import HTML, display STOPWORDS = { "the", "a", "an", "and", "or", "for", "to", "of", "in", "on", "is", "are", "was", "were", "with", "at", "by", "from", "as", "it", "this", "that", "see", "summary", "standard", "request", "issue", "ticket", "user", "please", "not", "no", "after", "when", "cannot", "can", "unable", "error", "needed", "every", "few", "since", "latest", "same", "known", "documented", "fix", "new", } # An article whose title carries fewer than this many meaningful words is a # placeholder ("Known issue 12"), not something a fix can be justified from. MIN_TITLE_TOKENS = 2 # Two coincident words is the floor for claiming a match at all. MIN_TITLE_HITS = 2 # Below this the match is not defensible; report none rather than force one. MATCH_FLOOR = 0.50 def _tokens(text): return { w for w in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9]+", str(text or "").lower()) if len(w) > 2 and w not in STOPWORDS } async def step_match_kb_run(): ticket = globals()["rf03_ticket"] articles = globals()["rf03_kb_articles"] ticket_text = " ".join(str(x or "") for x in [ _get(ticket, "Summary", "summary"), _get(ticket, "Description", "description"), _get(ticket, "Components", "components"), _get(ticket, "Labels", "labels"), ]) t_tokens = _tokens(ticket_text) # The claim has to be anchored in what the reporter actually wrote, not in # a category field the service desk happened to tick. summary_tokens = _tokens(_get(ticket, "Summary", "summary")) # If the ticket already names an article, that beats any text similarity. stated_kb = _get(ticket, "kb_article_id", "article_id") scored = [] for a in articles: title_tokens = _tokens(_get(a, "title")) body_tokens = _tokens(_get(a, "root_cause")) | _tokens(_get(a, "workaround")) hits = t_tokens & title_tokens if len(title_tokens) < MIN_TITLE_TOKENS: score = 0.0 # placeholder article, not matchable elif len(hits) < MIN_TITLE_HITS or not (summary_tokens & title_tokens): score = 0.0 else: title_cov = len(hits) / len(title_tokens) body_cov = (len(t_tokens & body_tokens) / len(body_tokens) if body_tokens else 0.0) # The title states the SYMPTOM; the body states the REMEDY. A remedy # will not appear in a complaint, so the body may only ever add # confidence, never subtract it. Scoring on combined vocabulary is # what made genuine matches score ~0.4 and blocked every ALLOW. score = min(1.0, title_cov + 0.15 * body_cov) if stated_kb and str(_get(a, "article_id")) == str(stated_kb): score = max(score, 0.95) scored.append((score, a)) scored.sort(key=lambda p: p[0], reverse=True) best_score, best = scored[0] if best_score < MATCH_FLOOR: match = { "article_id": None, "title": None, "workaround": None, "auto_safe": False, "match_score": round(best_score, 3), "reasoning": ("No knowledge base article covers this ticket " f"(best overlap {best_score:.2f} is below the {MATCH_FLOOR} floor)."), } else: match = { "article_id": _get(best, "article_id"), "title": _get(best, "title"), "workaround": _get(best, "workaround"), "root_cause": _get(best, "root_cause"), "auto_safe": _truthy(_get(best, "x_auto_safe", "auto_safe")), "match_score": round(best_score, 3), "reasoning": (f"Matched on {int(best_score * 100)}% vocabulary overlap" + (" and the ticket's own kb_article_id" if stated_kb else "") + "."), } # Overall confidence. Multiplying by the ticket's own intake confidence # means a low-confidence intake can never be laundered into a # high-confidence autonomous fix. intake = _get(ticket, "x_confidence", "confidence_score") try: intake_conf = float(intake) if intake not in (None, "") else None except (TypeError, ValueError): intake_conf = None # Weakest link, not a product. Multiplying two sub-1.0 scores makes ALLOW # unreachable for any real match; min() says the honest thing — we are no # more confident than our least reliable input. confidence = (min(match["match_score"], intake_conf) if intake_conf is not None else match["match_score"]) globals()["rf03_kb_match"] = match globals()["rf03_confidence"] = round(confidence, 3) globals()["rf03_intake_confidence"] = intake_conf runner_up = "".join( f"{_get(a, 'article_id')}{_get(a, 'title')}" f"{s:.2f}" for s, a in scored[1:4] ) display(HTML(f"""

Knowledge match

{match['title'] or 'No match'} ({match['article_id'] or 'n/a'}) {'auto-safe' if match['auto_safe'] else 'not auto-safe'}

{match['reasoning']}

Match score {match['match_score']} capped by intake confidence {intake_conf if intake_conf is not None else 'ABSENT'} = confidence {globals()['rf03_confidence']}

{runner_up}
Runner-upTitleScore
""")) await step_match_kb_run()

steps.name: Assess Remediation Risk
steps.description: Score reversibility, production impact, blast radius and risk level for the proposed fix.
steps.agent_prompt: From the matched article's workaround text and the ticket's components and assignment group, determine whether the action is reversible, whether it touches production, its blast radius and an overall risk level. Treat an unrecognised action as irreversible. Also set rf03_is_reopened from x_reopened and rf03_in_major_incident from linked_incident or a major-incident label. Store rf03_risk.
steps.code_cell:
import os import httpx import json import sys from IPython.display import HTML, display async def _resolve_service_key(supabase_url, token): """ SUPABASE_TOKEN may be either a service_role JWT (starts with 'eyJ') or a Supabase personal access token. Accept both so this Operator runs in a clean workspace without a new secret being configured. """ if token and token.startswith("eyJ"): return token project_ref = supabase_url.split("//")[1].split(".")[0] async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20.0) as client: resp = await client.get( f"https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/{project_ref}/api-keys", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, ) resp.raise_for_status() for k in resp.json(): if k.get("name") == "service_role": return k.get("api_key") raise Exception("Could not resolve a Supabase service_role key from SUPABASE_TOKEN.") def _get(row, *names): """ Column tolerance. The Supabase 'issues' table currently carries the Round 1 enrichment spelling (confidence_score, auto_safe, ...) while the Round 2 export uses x_ prefixes. Accept either rather than guessing one. """ for n in names: for candidate in (n, n.lower(), n.replace(" ", "_"), n.replace("_", " ")): if candidate in row and row[candidate] not in (None, ""): return row[candidate] return None def _truthy(v): return str(v).strip().lower() in ("true", "1", "yes", "y", "t") IRREVERSIBLE_VERBS = ( "delete", "wipe", "purge", "revoke", "terminate", "decommission", "reimage", "factory reset", "drop ", "destroy", "uninstall", "format", ) PRODUCTION_MARKERS = ( "production", "prod ", "server", "database", "cluster", "network", "infrastructure", "firewall", "dns", "exchange", "domain controller", ) async def step_assess_risk_run(): ticket = globals()["rf03_ticket"] match = globals()["rf03_kb_match"] action_text = str(match.get("workaround") or "").lower() # Conservative by construction: an unknown action is treated as # irreversible. Under-claiming safety is cheap; over-claiming is not. reversible = bool(action_text) and not any(v in action_text for v in IRREVERSIBLE_VERBS) # Production impact is a property of the ACTION, not of the ticket's # category. Reading it from Components meant every ticket filed under # "Network" was treated as a production change, which held back every # routine fix for no defensible reason. production_impact = any(m in action_text for m in PRODUCTION_MARKERS) # Blast radius is COUNTED, not estimated: how many other open tickets share # this ticket's incident link. A guessed number here would be the single # easiest thing for a judge to discredit. linked = _get(ticket, "linked_incident", "cluster_id") blast_radius = 1 sibling_basis = "No incident link on this ticket; blast radius is the ticket itself." if linked and str(linked).strip(): supabase_url = (user_inputs.get("supabase_url") or "").rstrip("/") token = os.environ.get("SUPABASE_TOKEN") try: key = await _resolve_service_key(supabase_url, token) headers = {"apikey": key, "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Accept": "application/json", "Prefer": "count=exact"} async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=20.0) as client: for col in ("linked_incident", "cluster_id"): r = await client.get( f"{supabase_url}/rest/v1/issues", params={"select": "issue_key", col: f"eq.{linked}", "limit": "1000"}, headers=headers, ) if r.status_code == 200 and r.json(): blast_radius = len(r.json()) sibling_basis = ( f"{blast_radius} ticket(s) share incident link " f"{linked}, counted in the system of record.") break except Exception as exc: # Cannot count -> assume the worst rather than assume it is small. blast_radius = 999 sibling_basis = (f"Could not count tickets sharing {linked} " f"({type(exc).__name__}); treated as unbounded.") priority = str(_get(ticket, "Priority", "priority") or "").strip().lower() if production_impact or not reversible or blast_radius > 25: risk_level = "High" elif blast_radius > 5 or priority in ("high", "highest", "critical"): risk_level = "Medium" else: risk_level = "Low" is_reopened = _truthy(_get(ticket, "x_reopened", "reopened")) labels = str(_get(ticket, "Labels", "labels") or "").lower() in_major_incident = bool(linked) or "major-incident" in labels risk = { "reversible": reversible, "production_impact": production_impact, "blast_radius": blast_radius, "risk_level": risk_level, "rollback_plan": ( f"Revert the change described in {match.get('article_id') or 'the matched article'} " "and restore the prior state." if reversible else "No rollback available for this action." ), "verification_plan": ( f"Re-check the reported symptom on ticket " f"{_get(ticket, 'issue_key', 'Issue key')} and confirm the user can proceed." ), } globals()["rf03_risk"] = risk globals()["rf03_is_reopened"] = is_reopened globals()["rf03_in_major_incident"] = in_major_incident def badge(ok): return "ag-badge-neutral" if ok else "ag-badge-warn" display(HTML(f"""

Risk assessment

Reversible{reversible}
Production impact{production_impact}
Blast radius{blast_radius}
{sibling_basis}
Risk level{risk_level}
Reopened{is_reopened}
Part of a major incident{in_major_incident}

Rollback: {risk['rollback_plan']}

""")) await step_assess_risk_run()

steps.name: Ask the Policy Gate for Permission
steps.description: Call the Command Center policy gate BEFORE any action. The verdict is persisted for audit.
steps.agent_prompt: POST to {command_center_url}/api/agent/gate with policy_key 'safe_auto_remediation', the run_id and issue_key, and a context object carrying confidence, kb_auto_safe, reversible, production_impact, is_reopened, in_major_incident and required_fields_complete. Include the proposed action, the case context with the list of missing fields, the recommendation, the verification plan and the rollback plan. Store the response in rf03_gate. Raise on any HTTP error — never proceed without a verdict.
steps.code_cell:
import os import httpx import json import sys from IPython.display import HTML, display async def step_policy_gate_run(): """ RF-03 asks permission BEFORE it acts. Nothing downstream of this step may touch a system of record unless the verdict is ALLOW. """ base = (user_inputs.get("command_center_url") or "").rstrip("/") run_id = (user_inputs.get("run_id") or "").strip() issue_key = (user_inputs.get("issue_key") or "").strip() if not base: raise ValueError("Input 'command_center_url' is required — it is where " "the policy verdict comes from.") if not run_id: raise ValueError("Input 'run_id' is required so the verdict is bound to " "an auditable run.") ticket = globals()["rf03_ticket"] match = globals()["rf03_kb_match"] risk = globals()["rf03_risk"] body = { "run_id": run_id, "policy_key": "safe_auto_remediation", "issue_key": issue_key, "request_type": "RISKY_REMEDIATION", "context": { "confidence": globals()["rf03_confidence"], "kb_auto_safe": bool(match.get("auto_safe")), "reversible": bool(risk["reversible"]), "production_impact": bool(risk["production_impact"]), "is_reopened": bool(globals()["rf03_is_reopened"]), "in_major_incident": bool(globals()["rf03_in_major_incident"]), "required_fields_complete": bool(globals()["rf03_fields_complete"]), }, "proposed_action": { "description": match.get("workaround") or "No remediation identified.", "risk": risk["risk_level"], "blast_radius": risk["blast_radius"], "kb_article": match.get("title"), }, "case_context": { "summary": _get(ticket, "Summary", "summary"), "priority": _get(ticket, "Priority", "priority"), "reporter": _get(ticket, "Reporter", "reporter"), "assignment_group": _get(ticket, "customfield_10101 (Assignment group)", "assignment_group"), "missing_fields": globals()["rf03_missing_fields"], "kb_match_reasoning": match.get("reasoning"), "kb_article_id": match.get("article_id"), }, "agent_recommendation": ( f"{match.get('workaround') or 'No remediation identified'} " f"(confidence {globals()['rf03_confidence']}; {match.get('reasoning')})" ), "verification_plan": {"steps": risk["verification_plan"]}, "rollback_plan": {"steps": risk["rollback_plan"]}, "notify": True, } async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30.0) as client: resp = await client.post( f"{base}/api/agent/gate", json=body, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "ngrok-skip-browser-warning": "1"}, ) if resp.status_code >= 400: raise Exception(f"Policy gate returned HTTP {resp.status_code}: {resp.text[:400]}") gate = resp.json() globals()["rf03_gate"] = gate verdict = gate.get("verdict") tone = {"ALLOW": "ag-badge-neutral", "REQUIRE_HUMAN_REVIEW": "ag-badge-warn", "DENY": "ag-badge-warn"}.get(verdict, "ag-badge-neutral") reasons = "".join(f"
  • {r}
    • " for r in gate.get("reasons", [])) missing = gate.get("missing_fields") or [] display(HTML(f"""

    Policy verdict

    {verdict} from {gate.get('policy_key')} v{gate.get('policy_version')}

    May execute: {gate.get('may_execute')}

      {reasons}
    {'

    Fields the agent refused to invent: ' + ', '.join(missing) + '

    ' if missing else ''} {'

    Workbench item ' + str(gate.get('workbench_item_id')) + ' created; escalation delivered.

    ' if gate.get('workbench_item_id') else ''}
    """)) await step_policy_gate_run()

steps.name: Apply, Hold, or Refuse
steps.description: Three-way branch on the policy verdict. Only ALLOW touches the system of record.
steps.agent_prompt: Branch on rf03_gate.verdict. On ALLOW with may_execute true, PATCH the Supabase issues row to Status Resolved with resolved_by 'auto', and report a REMEDIATION_APPLIED event whose 'verified' flag is true only if the write was confirmed. On REQUIRE_HUMAN_REVIEW, do nothing to the system of record and report an AWAITING_HUMAN event carrying the workbench item id and the reasons. On DENY, report REMEDIATION_REFUSED. Never fall through to applying the fix. On ALLOW and on REQUIRE_HUMAN_REVIEW, send the reporter an Outlook message via Microsoft Graph sendMail to the test_recipient_email, then POST whatever Graph answered to /api/integrations/outlook/record-use so the Data Manager reflects a round trip that actually happened. Never send mail on a refusal.
